content.title: Why Invesco (IVZ) Stock Is Trading Up Today
content.summary: Shares of asset management firm Invesco (NYSE:IVZ) jumped 2.9% in the afternoon session after the company announced it agreed to repurchase $500 million of its preference shares. The asset manager agreed to buy back the shares from Massachusetts Mutual Life Insurance Company at an 18% premium. A repurchase, especially at a premium, can signal management's confidence in the company's financial standing.
